name: express-render

platform.name: Render
platform.why: render.yaml declares one web service (runtime node, plan free)

processes.note: startCommand node app.js; app.js listens on PORT

notes: The repository is six files: app.js, package.json, render.yaml, yarn.lock, README.md, LICENSE. app.js serves one HTML page; the page's inline <script> calls setTimeout for a confetti effect, which runs in the browser, but it sits inside a template string in server code and no rule matches setTimeout, so it is not listed as a trap. No store, no queue, no timer, no session and no disk write on the server; the expected result is a clean audit with one web process.
